name: Content Repurposing
description: Turn a long-form article into a Twitter thread, short video script, and email newsletter.

stages.name: Summarise article
stages.prompt: Read the supplied article. Produce a 6-bullet summary plus the 3 sharpest pull-quotes.

stages.name: Twitter thread
stages.prompt: Turn the summary into a 7-tweet thread. Hook tweet must be < 240 chars.

stages.name: Short video script
stages.prompt: Turn the summary into a 60-second voice-over script with [B-ROLL] hints.

stages.name: Email newsletter
stages.prompt: Turn the summary into a 250-word email newsletter with a subject line and one CTA.
